cell_type_context: Virus-elicited mouse effector CD8 T cells; IL-15 stimulation and conditional STAT5 deletion with Bcl-2 expression and effector-cell maintenance assays
compartment_context: Extracellular IL-15; IL2RB/IL2RG receptor complex; JAK1/JAK3 and nuclear STAT5; Bcl2 survival-associated gene output
injury_context: no SCI transfer inferred; antiviral effector-T-cell comparator model only
context_scope: Primary study shows IL-15 and IL-7 converge on STAT5 and require STAT5 to induce Bcl-2 expression in effector CD8 T cells, preserving cytokine, lineage, and in-vivo infection context
assay_or_perturbation: IL-15 stimulation; conditional STAT5 deletion; Bcl-2 expression measurement; effector CD8 T-cell maintenance and viral-infection model
citation_note: Primary study reports IL-15/STAT5-dependent Bcl-2 expression in effector CD8 T cells; primary locator: PMID:20644163
evidence_summary: Primary-supported claim: IL-15 signaling through the IL2RB/IL2RG complex and JAK/STAT5 is associated with Bcl-2 induction in effector CD8 T cells, and STAT5 deletion impairs the output. This supplies a BCL2 output for the existing IL-15/JAK1/JAK3/STAT5 route.
limitations: The primary output study demonstrates functional STAT5 dependence but does not establish direct STAT5 occupancy at the BCL2 promoter in the IL-15 experiment, and the reused STAT5-BCL2 edge is context-bounded.
